class.name: IfcShellBasedSurfaceModel
class.brief_description: Definition from ISO/CD 10303-42:1992 : A shell based surface model is described by a set of open or closed shells of dimensionality 2. The shells shall not intersect except at edges and vertices. In particular, distinct faces may not intersect. A complete face of one shell may be shared with another shell.
